What's so special about Tanaka's "dazzling daily life"? An original one-shot by the authors of Kieta Hatsukoi.

(Source: Betsuma, translated)

170085.description:
At a bar, Dong Ling, who is about to graduate from the police academy, meets Bai Ruowei, a cute and innocent-looking rich girl. These two unrelated women turn out to be inextricably linked to an old, unsolved case. Meanwhile, the playboy Zhao Zhi, who dislikes his fiancée Bai Ruowei, becomes more interested in her when he discovers that she might not be not as dumb as he thought...

(Souce: Bilibili, translated)

170086.description:
After 500 years of closed-door cultivation, Ye Jieyu emerged to find the world has changed drastically. In this modern world, other powers are on the rise and traditional martial arts have declined in importance. His former disciples have all become bigwigs in various fields. See how the old master will come to rule the modern city after coming down from the mountain!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.english: the patriarch has left the mountain

170088.description:
After vowing to spend the rest of their lives together, Kanade plans to celebrate Mashiro’s birthday with a surprise, but things don’t exactly go to plan. How will Kanade react when Mashiro does something that really ticks him off? Is their first trip away together destined for stormy weather?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title.english: Stay By My Side After the Rain
title.native: 雨上がりの僕らについて ―ever after―
title.romaji: Ameagari no Bokura ni Tsuite: ever after

170090.description: Young Michiru moves in with her cousin's family in Tokyo's Kouenji district to seek a better education for herself. Seeking a a more secure future for herself after witnessing her mother remarrying for financial security she has dreams of becoming an independent OL. While dealing with her anxiety for the future she becomes drawn to the neighborhood boy Tooru, however she quickly finds she is competing with her cousin for his affection... As this tense love triangle plays out new possibilities for Michiru's future open up.

170091.description: Hinowa and Tsukinowa are two sisters who couldn't be more different. One day Tsukinowa reveals her ambition of becoming the queen of the Yamato people who will lead them to the great world beyond the sea. Shocked by this proclamation Hinowa starts paying close attention to her sister, and soon finds out about the powerful magic entity that attached itself to her...

title.romaji: Hi no Wa, Tsuki no Wa

170092.description:
After slipping and hitting her head on a rainy day, Ayla wakes up in another world filled with spells and beasts. In her new life, Ayla enjoys her everyday freedom in a small village as an alchemist. However, one day, she encounters a rare species of beast she'd heard about in legends. Despite her initial astonishment at his frightful appearance, she notices he is in pain... Ayla tries to help him, but a bottle of aphrodisiacs she had on her accidentally gets poured over her head...!!

The beast kisses her as if devouring her and wraps his tentacle―like tails around her body.

Just who is this beast... who indulges her in pleasure in an effort to help wear the medicine off?

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Chapter count includes two volume-bonus chapters.

title.english: Reincarnated As The Dragon's Personal Witch Doctor
title.native: 転生魔女は竜族の魔物様に囲われます
title.romaji: Tensei Majo wa Ryuuzoku no Mamono-sama ni Kakowaremasu

170093.description:
I had yearned for the tranquility of the countryside, but destiny had other plans. Suddenly, I found myself transported to an entirely new world. Within Novice Village, I ascended to the status of a creation-level entity. And then, against all odds, I defeated the Demon Empress who ruled this realm—with only a dog I had raised by my side. From that pivotal moment, the defeated Demon Empress took up residence in my humble home, and my extraordinary adventure in this otherworldly domain began.

(Source: Webnovel)

170094.description:
The history of the Toyota Corolla from the1960s to the 2020s, as told through five real-life stories about everyday life with a Corolla.
Published on the Toyota website to celebrate the 50 millionth Toyota Corolla sold in 2021.

170095.description:
During the war, Achilles is in love with his uncle Roscoe. Achilles presses Roscoe for a physical relationship, but Roscoe refuses. Heartbroken, Achilles moves from one war zone to another until he meets a man...

(Source: Akane Shinsha)
synonyms: カミング・ホーム after

170096.description:
Saburo moved to Okinawa with this parents. Wanting to change his gloomy "yakkyakko" personality, he tries to act like a delinquent, but he fails miserably and ends up as a shunned loner. Saburo is despondent, but that all changes when he catches the attention of an Okinawan gal named Maya. They skip school and travel around Okinawa, as she drags him along to play with her endlessly! The excitement keeps Saburo on the edge of his seat, and furthermore, Saburo and Maya actually share a secret ......!

Feel the thrill of Okinawa x Gyaru x ? in a hot tropical romantic comedy!

(Source: ComicWalker, translated)

170097.description:
Uta (who has newly come out as gay) and Ryo (seemingly straight) have been living together for a year and a half. At first, they had their fights. They also slept together. But these days, they're as tranquil as a middle-aged married couple. Only problem is...they haven't had sex or kissed in almost a year. With their lease renewal hanging over his head, Uta is wondering if it even makes sense for them to continue this way. Why would a gay man and a straight man who aren't dating or even sleeping together keep living like a couple?

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

title.english: Is This the Kind of Love I Want?
title.native: こんな恋なら終わりにしたい！
title.romaji: Konna Koi nara Owari ni Shitai!

170098.description:
Yamada Seina's life is already teetering on the edge—between juggling high school, managing her friendships, and covering her rent solo, she barely has time to breathe. But when she nearly falls prey to a scammer and loses her hard-earned rent money, things go from bad to worse. Just when it seems like she's hit rock bottom, a mysterious (and incredibly handsome) stranger with horns swoops in, claiming he's a demon king who's crossed dimensions just to be with her. Why? Because, according to him, Seina is the reincarnation of his lost love!

Skeptical but unable to shake him off, Seina finds herself with a new, otherworldly roommate who's hellbent on keeping her safe, whether she wants his protection or not. What's a girl to do when her biggest problem suddenly becomes a supernatural—and superhot—roommate?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
synonyms: The World's Most Overprotective Demon King

title.english: The Demon King is Way Too Overprotective!
title.native: 世にも過保護な魔王サマ

170099.description:
Ryuuki Shirao, who has been working part-time at a convenience store for many years, has regular customers who always do the same shopping. Shirao couldn't help but notice that he had a unkempt head, a stubble, and a slovenly appearance, but he was strangely friendly and had a nice smell. "What do you usually do with a look like that? One day, a regular man who appeared in a different appearance than usual is really handsome!! There was--!?

Note: Includes an extra chapter.

title.native: ヤバめの恋は計画的に
title.romaji: Yabame no Koi wa Keikakuteki ni

170100.description:
The ashes of past feelings are still smoldering in their hearts, and now they'll get reignited... A mysterious reunion love story between a cop and a private eye by the masterful Yuzu Marita!

(Source: Renta!)

170101.description:
Sumiko Kiyota is a plain, ordinary girl with a serious demeanor. While eating lunch alone as usual, Yuki Shirakawa, the most beautiful and popular girl in class, calls out to her...?

(Source: Tonari no Young Jump, translated)

title.native: 清田さんは汚されたい

170102.description:
The series picks up three years after Kotaro's birth and focuses on Kentaro and Aki trying to raise Kotaro despite their conflicting work schedules. They begin to consider the possibility of living together and having another child. Meanwhile, pop sensation Seiya Aoyagi has become pregnant with fellow pop singer Asakawa Sakura's baby and decides to raise it, causing a rift between them. Kentaro's boss, Hiromi Shimomura becomes pregnant with his mistress' baby. He is in denial, but must come to terms with the growing evidence of his adultery.

(Source: Wikipedia)
synonyms: Kentaro Hiyama's First Pregnancy: Childcare Edition

title.native: ヒヤマケンタロウの妊娠 育児編
title.romaji: Hiyama Kentarou no Ninshin: Ikuji Hen

title.native: 断頭台に消えた伝説の悪女、二度目の人生ではガリ勉地味眼鏡になって平穏を望む
title.romaji: Dantoudai ni Kieta Densetsu no Akujo, Nidome no Jinsei de wa Gariben Jimi Megane ni Natte Heion wo Nozomu

170104.description:
On a night out, Hiyori tells her friends that she badly wants a boyfriend. A rude man overhears her and says, "Love is worthless."

(Source: Manga Planet)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.english: I’ve Never Done This Before: Serious Blind Love Sex with a Popular Guy
title.native: こんなのハジメテ ～モテ男の本気の溺愛エッチ～
title.romaji: Konna no Hajimete: Moteo no Honki no Dekiai Ecchi

170105.description:
When Ohta's work led him to get transfered to London, he was initially all over the moon. But as months pass by, feelings of homesickness start creeping in and Ohta can't help but feel out of place in the streets of the foreign country. As fate would have it, Ohta is reunited with an old acquaintance, Yukisada, and the both of them are just drawn to each other like moths to a flame.

(Source: Manga Planet)

Notes:
- Original serialization ran for seven chapters. In the volume release, Chapters 6 and 7 were combined as Chapter 6.
- Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: ヘブンリーホームシック

170106.description: The main character that loves the MMORPG Dunex more than anyone, in exchange for clearing the event he was transported inside the game world. However, he was transported as a fat mob villain.

title.native: 災悪のアヴァロン ～ゲーム最弱の悪役デブに転移したけど、俺だけ“やせれば強くてニューゲーム”な世界だったので、最速レベルアップ＆破滅フラグ回避で影の英雄を目指します～
title.romaji: Saiaku no Avalon: Game Saijaku no Akuyaku Debu ni Teni Shita kedo, Ore dake "Yasereba Tsuyokute New Game" na Sekai Datta node, Saisoku Level Up & Hametsu Flag Kaihi de Kage no Eiyuu wo Mezashimasu

170107.description:
A scheduling error at a business partner's company reunites the two childhood friends, Kai and Masa. But their third childhood friend, Jun, is not there... She and Masa have divorced. Kai, normally disinterested in romance, sees for the first time a glimmer of hope for his lifelong unrequited love towards Masa. Masa, for his part, seems to use every opportunity to spend time with Kai, but he also seems to have things left unsaid with Jun. How will the three of them navigate their old friendship and their uncertain futures...?

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

synonyms: How I Matched With My Neighbor's Plump Wife

title.native: おとなりさんのムチムチ若妻とマッチングしちゃった話
title.romaji: Otonari-san no Muchimuchi Wakazuma to Matching Shichatta Hanashi

170109.description:
I was a promising pitcher but because of Ha-Eun, I injured my shoulder and couldn't play anymore. Now I am living because I'm so afraid to die. One day, seeing Ha-Eun makes the fire of revenge light in my heart.

“I'll dominate you Ha-Eun!”

(Source: DAYcomics)
synonyms: Forcing the Woman I Despise Into Submission
讓傲慢女屈服的一百種方法

title.english: Dominating a Girl That You Hate

170111.description:
Story following the exploits and updates in Phantasy Star Online 2: New Genesis through the Central Tower girls and a rotating cast of characters.

PSO2 New Genesis: Central! is a series originally released on the Phantasy Star Online 2 official site, and published in print by MUGENUP. The series has been simultaneously published digitally in English on the English-language Phantasy Star Online 2 official site.

(Source: MyAnimeList)
synonyms: PSO2 ニュージェネシス せんとらるっ！
Phantasy Star Online 2 New Genesis: Central!

彼女とカノジョと罰ゲームと
title.romaji: Kanojo to Kanojo to Badgame to

彼女ちゃんの言うとおり
ハーレムサーヴァント
ハーレムリベンジャー 復讐の美女とおねショタ流離譚
title.romaji: Harem Revenge: Fukushu no Bijo to One Shota Ruritan

170131.description:
A century ago, the divine dragon sealed away the Dragon-Slaying Queen as revenge against the kingdom. But through the dedication of the queen’s successors, the kingdom has enjoyed great prosperity. Kriemhild, the daughter of the fifth queen, ascends to the throne with the same determination to protect the kingdom. Her elder sister Brunhild fell victim to the corruption of divine power, much like predecessors. Bearing that burden, Kriemhild steps into the throne room. But what awaits her is the kingdom's greatest darkness, known only to those who become queens.

(Source: Yen Press)

title.native: クリムヒルトとブリュンヒルド
推しのアイドルが露出狂だった件。
title.romaji: Oshi no Idol ga Roshutsukyou datta Ken.

170133.description:
Hirose Itsuki is a high school girl who doesn't like to have unrealistic hopes or dreams, afraid of getting hurt. One day, Hino, the school's star basketball player, forced to the sidelines because of an injury, asks her, "Do you know any good ways to pass the time?" They begin to study together and gradually become close, but when Itsuki hears Hino's true feelings in a moment of weakness, she runs away and they grow apart. After many months, they finally meet again, as new medical students at the same university…

(Source: Cocohana, translated)

170135.description:
Manga artist Toraji Yamamura's serialized work “Revenge Clown” had been approved for film adaptation. Supported by his loving wife, he was celebrating the greatest night of both his professional and personal life. But this was merely the start of the nightmare about to unfold...What is the unprecedented murderous intent born from unconscious malice? Who is the mysterious and vengeful “Pierrot-Man”...?!

(Source: emaqi)

title.native: 私が初めておじさんのおち〇ちんを触った日
title.romaji: Watashi ga Hajimete Oji-san no Ochinchin wo Sawatta Hi

170137.description: Aida-san, a member of the going-home club who tends to give up on everything, suddenly turns into a magical girl one day! She turns to Shiranami-san, the class president with a strong sense of responsibility, for advice, but…?

170138.description:
Seichi, a normal college student, meets Rey, a beautiful and world renowned model. Seichi retrieves Rey's stolen bag from a burglar, and gets a passionate kiss from Rey with a promise to return the favor...! He's then invited to a luxurious dinner where he gets drunk and passes out, only to wake up in bed next to a naked Rey...!! "I've come to want you," Rey tells Seichi and kisses him with tongue while playing with his nipples, and his dick is getting wet... The gorgeous model is arrogantly assertive...!! A story of a gorgeous Cinderella!

(Source: Mobile Media Research)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.english: Egotistical Sex with an Arrogant Celebrity
title.native: 傲慢セレブのエゴイスティック・セックス

170139.description:
In order to drive away his persistent previous boyfriend, Yuzuha, one of a set of twins who are popular influencers, declares he’ll start a relationship with the passerby pudgy underclassman Yachiro. Although he was partially caught up in it, the kind Yachiro went along with it and agreed to pretend to be his boyfriend. Yuzuha fully enjoys playing at being lovers with warm and squishy Yachiro. However, when Yachiro loses weight and drastically changes into a gorgeous man, his heart won’t stop fluttering...!?

(Source: Gush, translated)
170139.hashtag: #俺の恋心が弄ばれています
synonyms: My Love Is Being Played With

title.native: 俺の恋心が弄ばれています

170140.description:
In a politically arranged marriage devoid of love, Lily is wed to Theodore, the head of a rival family. Theodore loathes the union, but little does he know that Lily despises her own family as much as he does. Living a quiet life, she counts the days until their inevitable divorce. Then fate intervenes—a sudden accident erases Theodore’s memories of her, transforming his coldness into unexpected affection. Can Lily trust this dramatic shift, or must she guard her heart to avoid future heartbreak?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes six extra chapters.
synonyms: My Husband Hates Me, But He Lost His Memories
สามีที่เกลียดข้าสูญเสียความทรงจำ
My Resentful Husband Lost His Memories
恨我的老公失去了記憶

title.english: My Husband Who Hates Me Has Lost His Memories

170141.description:
Witches who defy the law must face judgment. 150 years ago, witches descended from the moon, and ever since, this country has promoted and fostered a deep bond between them and its people. However, not all witches abide by the law. Chosen from their own ranks, an “Enforcer” brings them to justice. Among them is Witch Natalia, who one day encounters a boy afflicted by a curse...?!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

Note: Includes one epilogue chapter.

title.native: ヘラクレス 英雄への道

170143.description: Also includes Urusai Imouto-tachi (うるさい妹たち), and Parisienne (パリジェンヌ)

170144.description: Note: Included in Oshimai as Vol. 6 Ch. 5

title.native: ビーチでのそれぞれの青春
夜の檸檬にリクエスト

170146.description:
Loanna was raised in neglect and isolation as an illegitimate child of the Count Louis family. She gets married off to Duke Bruggen, who orders her to keep quiet and out of the way. Free from all expectations or responsibilities, she roams around the castle and runs into a coffee bush. A passionate barista in her past life, Loanna remembers exactly how to brew a perfect cup of Joe. The trouble is, no one in this realm seems to know what "coffee" is, nor its wonderful benefits. As a matter of fact, coffee fruits are regarded as "evil." As a coffee aficionado, Loanna is determined to turn this reputation around.

(Source: Pocket Comics)
synonyms: 転生バリスタと無愛想な公爵様
ร้านกาแฟของดัชเชสสายชิล

170147.description:
In my mom's arms, in 3 years, I love the smell of her skin. While hugging me, though, she starts to see the man in me...

"I can give you everything, my son."

(Source: DAYcomics)
synonyms: Is It Your Mother or Sister?
母さんor姉ちゃんどっちにスる？

title.english: Night with My Mother and Sister

title.native: ふたなり地味娘と無口な男の娘の着せかえ睡眠姦
title.romaji: Futanari Jimi Musume to Mukuchina Otokonoko no Kisekae Suiminkan

synonyms: Sensei No Saamen Kudasaai! ~Saimin Zumi Gakuen De Zenra Joshiseitotachi To Haaremu Pako Pako Raifu~

title.native: 催淫即ハメ先生～催眠腕輪で学園の女子生徒を片っ端からヤりまくるっ～
title.romaji: Saiin Sokuhame Sensei: Saimin Udewa de Gakuen no Joshi Seito wo Katappashikara Yarimakuru

170150.description:
Moto's childhood friend Hiroaki is a little eccentric, and has no problem blurring the lines in their relationship... What's worse, they both keep saying the opposite of what they mean, and misunderstandings abound! Moto has been nursing a crush on Hiro for years. They've stayed friends even after graduating from college, but as a grown man, Hiro still can't do his own chores. Moto's taken it upon himself as Hiro's best friend to look after him day to day, while hiding his romantic feelings and creeping possessiveness. But, one day out of the blue, Hiro announces that he's dating another guy! Bewildered and full of regret, Moto tries to act like nothing's changed...until he accidentally spies the two of them getting it on, and gets caught by Hiro! Finally, Moto tells Hiro he can't be friends anymore, only to be blindsided again!

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: のぞけない俺でもゆるして

170151.description:
Actress Lee Sia hasn't just been haunted by ghosts for years, she's also been plagued by dreams of a girl named Camilla Sorphel dying repeatedly at the hands of her stepfather and stepbrother. Despite her efforts to ignore the dreams, when an accident at work makes her wake up as Camilla, she's forced to seek the help of various ghosts to win over her family and avoid getting killed. But can this former actress play the part of a loving daughter and sister to her future executors?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: เลดี้ผู้ทำนายโชคชะตา
公女様は未来を見通す

170152.description:
Instead of being caught by Prince Charming, I've fallen into a complete nightmare! Not only did I transmigrate into a trashy romance fantasy novel, but I fell from the sky and ended up in the arms of the mad villain, Edwin Crawford. Before I knew it, he called me his wife from the heavens and was raving about some prophecy. I don't even know who I am, so how can I be his wife?! Until I figure out what is happening, will it be safe to stay in the embrace of the Mad Dragon of the West?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: Fell Into the Arms of a Mad Villain
ฉันหล่นลงในอ้อมอกของวายร้ายจอมคลั่ง

title.english: Falling into the Arms of a Mad Villain

170153.description:
What do you do when a murderous villain ends up unconscious at your front door? For Yuri, the answer is simple: leave his body outside protagonist Anne-Marie's house and then live in peace as a background character! But for some reason, Yuri can't bring herself to let him ruin sweet, innocent Anne-Marie's life as is written in the original story, so she takes him in and slowly nurses him back to health. Little does Yuri realize the consequences of letting a villain inside her house...

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: You Have Got the Wrong House, Villain

title.english: This Is the Wrong House, Mr. Villain!

170154.description:
Her favorite character's fate is in her hands.

A woman's dream comes true when she transmigrates into the body of Rachel Agnes, sister of Liz Agnes — her favorite story villain. Her mission? Ensure that Liz goes down a better path. Yet, things become more complicated than expected, especially when a notorious archduke is thrown into the mix...

(Source: Manta)
synonyms: I Need to Raise My Sister Right
Querida Irmã, Não Seja a Vilã
เมื่อพี่สาวต้องเลี้ยงน้องสาวให้เป็นเด็กดี

170155.description:
What gives?! Lady Doreen Bradshaw is wise enough to make her father a fortune with her investments but not old enough to legally make any choices for herself! On top of that, it seems every adult in her life either sees her as a golden goose or a beautiful bride-to-be. Is the fluctuating price of Lady Doreen’s freedom something not even the genius herself can predict?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: ミリオネア・レディー

170157.description:
Astin Seymour is the antagonist in the romance novel The Story of Lillie. Her jealousy of the protagonist, Lillie, is what fuels her cruelty. However, now that I have taken over her body, the plot is changing. The real Astin hated Lillie, but she’s now my best friend. I would never hurt her, but I’m scared the real Astin will take over and harm Lillie. Because of that, I have no choice but to return to the world I came from. The only problem is… I have no recollection of that world.

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: The Villainess Wants to Go Home

170160.description:
Io and Haruhito, members of the boy band ASH, are secret lovers. They have a fulfilling life both in their private and public lives, but it seems that Io has a problem that he can't even tell Haruhito...? This is a love story about the frustrating love between a prince idol and a cute idol.

Note: Chapter count includes a bonus chapter and an extra chapter between Kazusa and Ikuto of "Doted on by my oshi".

title.native: ハニーグレーズ モノポリー

170161.description:
Ruzo was selected for the once-every-10-year Knife Award, a top honor for chefs, but due to sabotage from the jealous fellow chef Tatsuzo, he was disgraced and committed suicide. Furthermore, Tatsuzo also causes the deaths of Tomezo's wife Ofuji, who was pregnant with child, and his disciple Otomatsu. Omino, Ruzo's only remaining daughter, sacrifices her happiness and risks her life to to take revenge on Tatsuzo by becoming a chef herself.

(Source: Mangapedia, translated)

170162.description:
1. Frustration (フラストレーション)
2. Impression (インプレッション)
3. Strike Zone (ストライクゾーン)
4. Hajimete no Date / First Date (はじめてのデート)
5. Private Bunny (プライベートバニー)
6. IN FACT
7. Geranium (ゼラニウム)

title.native: フラストレーションガールズ

170163.description:
Six years ago, humanity was almost brought to an end when mysterious towers filled the skies across the globe, unleashing deadly monsters. Fortunately, the people known as “players” emerged, blessed with supernatural powers that they harnessed to save mankind. Among them is Yuseong Kang, a phenomenal player who has saved the world time after time. Once again, he has successfully averted global catastrophe… and in an internationally broadcasted interview praising his heroic endeavors, he says,

“I’m just in it for the money.”

(Source: WEBTOON)

170164.description:
Kaede, a young woman, has given herself a much more masculine haircut. Despite her insistence that it was merely out of her own preference, she still receives some hassle for it. On her way home from work, frustrated, she stumbles upon Yoshino, a battered young woman - and one that seems to have had problems with men....

A 'girl meets girl' one-shot that gazes upon "our real selves".

title.native: ありのまんまのあなた

170165.description:
Flair is the youngest magical artisan to ever be appointed to the royal court... and she's under constant harassment from her superior who leaves her with so much work that she almost never gets to go home. The one person who has been there for her, her fiancé, also suddenly decides to call off their engagement, leaving her at rock bottom. However, after coming across the second prince of the kingdom caught in a terrible curse, everything changes. Flair helps him fight off this curse, but the only way to remove it is by finding who exactly casted it...

(Source: MangaPlaza)
synonyms: The Unaware Genius Magical Tool Artisan Just Wants To Live a Quiet Life

title.english: The Clueless Genius Magical Artisan Wants to Lead a Leisurely Life
title.native: 無自覚な天才魔導具師はのんびり暮らしたい
title.romaji: Mujikakuna Tensai Majutsushi wa Nonbiri Kurashitai

170167.description:
On her seventeenth birthday, the apprentice witch Meg learns that she only has one year left to live. Her teacher, the long-lived witch Faust, explains that the only way to undo the death curse is to collect tears of joy and grow the seed of life. To find them, Meg will have to leave the sheltered life she's always known and head out into the world. There will be meetings, partings, and friendships aplenty, and of course many tears. Meg will learn that the most important lessons for a witch are bright, sweet, and somewhat heart-wrenching.

(Source: Yen Press)
synonyms: The Tale of the One Thousand Tears of Joy
The Curtain Rises on a Neverending Story

On her seventeenth birthday, the apprentice witch Meg learns that she only has one year left to live. But one day, things start to oddly go missing from his house. His shampoo, his remote, his half-eaten apple and his most precious toy! Maybe he’s just absent-mindedly misplacing things these days, he is stressed out at work after all. That’s what he thought anyway, until one day he came home and caught the thief red-handed! The only problem is, this thief isn’t just your plain old neighborhood cat burglar, in fact he’s not from Heesu’s neighborhood at all! This thief is from another dimension and now Heesu is trapped there too. Hm, this thief is kinda cute…but no more toying around, Heesu’s gotta get back home anyway he can!

However, unable to bear the harassment of my boss and my own mental issues, I ended up returning home soon after. As if to escape, I stayed in the bathtub, where I felt most at home. 170751.description:
Starting off as 4koma and published online to promote the titular Transformers Legends toyline, with special Bonus Edition (出張版 Shutchōban) chapters of the comic packed with the toys themselves, it Initially showcased the misadventures of the Beast Wars cast re-imagined as adult Transformers fans, before eventually taking a more story-driven approach and attempting to connect all the entries of the Japanese Generation 1 anime and manga continuity into one storyline.

Heavily marketed towards adult collectors and otaku in the face of the brand's dwindling popularity with children after TakaraTomy's largely unsuccessful first attempt in the mid-2000s, it attempted to change the image of the Transformers franchise, with much more "adult", often ecchi-filled humour and numerous references to fan culture.

Ulltimately concluded when TakaraTomy began a brand unification with Hasbro starting with Power of the Primes, deciding to mainly sell Hasbro toys as is with minimal changes to packaging. It was eventually succeeded by the more action-oriented Generations Selects Special Comic promoting Hasbro and TakaraTomy's joint Generations Selects imprint.

(Source: TFwiki, edited)

Orphaned at a young age and drowning in her father’s debts, Anastasia spent her days starving despite being a noble. One day, her uncle, Count Everdeen, proposed to pay off her family’s debts if she agreed to get engaged to his enemy, Duke Theodore. Having no better alternatives, she accepted her uncle’s offer and moved to Theodore’s palace. Despised by Theodore and his servants, all kinds of mistreatments awaited Anastasia, from ruining her dress to serving her rotten food, with the last straw of Theodore telling her it was a good thing her parents died. However, Anastasia's lonely and depressing life takes a turn when she encounters a gentleman at a ball...

(Source: POCKET COMICS)
synonyms: If You Wish For My Despair
If You So Desire My Despair

title.english: To You Who Wish For My Despair
title.native: あなたが私の絶望を願うなら
title.romaji: Anata ga Watashi no Zetsubou wo Negau nara

170814.description:
Izumi realizes from a young age that his romantic orientation is towards the same sex. Even when he becomes an adult, he hides that fact, and pretends to be like everyone else. One day, on his way home from a business dinner, he gets embraced by a young man who exclaims "It's you, Kou-kun, isn't it...?! I've always wanted to meet you!" The guy in question is his friend he had lost contact with eight years ago, Shion... Who is also the boy he felt guilty towards for being attracted to, and whom he distanced himself from all those years ago. Questioned why they suddenly lost contact, Izumi blurts out that he always loved Shion, to which Shion replies that he feels the same... They end up dating, and they're lovey-dovey and happy, but sometimes Shion's behavior seems off...?

(Source: Kasakura Shuppansha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

170815.description:
Takara Shun, a high school student who belongs to a popular group in the class, and Taichi Amagi, a pure boy who is not a conspicuous type but is liked by people, realize their love for each other. Even though they start dating in secret, it is difficult to be honest.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

170817.description: Ryouichirou Kezuka's self-produced works done before Onban Kikou was published.

170818.description:
Until just a few days ago, Si-U Choi was your typical high school student. But suddenly he finds out he’s a descendant of the goblin clan, and thus a half-demon. In a dark realm of another world there lives the Demon King, the demon who rules over the night and reigns over all demons of the world. Now, the fight for the throne begins.

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)
synonyms: คืนแห่งโทแกบี

170819.description:
Richii's parents died in an accident when he was in junior high school, leaving him alone with his doting sister Towa. Three years later, his sister also disappears, and even Riichi is summoned to another world where he is reunited with his sister. In the other world, Towa has become the most powerful hero!

This is an erotic love comedy in another world where beautiful women are always pestering our protagonist!

title.native: 異世界ホテルへようこそ ~魔族で勇者な最強姉たちから溺愛されて困ってます~
title.romaji: Isekai Hotel e Youkoso: Mazoku de Yuusha na Saikyou Ane-tachi kara Dekiaisarete Komattemasu

title.native: オーダーメイドな恋をして
title.romaji: Order Made na Koi wo Shite

170821.description:
Several years have passed since the war that engulfed the world. A small country in the north, at the mercy of the interests of the major powers, still has a war-torn country and its people. Elena, a girl with cat ears, begins working at a mansion where the seriously ill and injured who are unable to move their bodies are finally gathered. What awaits Elena is a harsh reality in which the value of life is shaken. Even so, the passion of Elena's belief in the preciousness of life and the possibility of life will eventually spread to the people around her and to the whole country, and become something big.

This is the story of a girl who becomes a great light in a reality where the future is as uncertain as the deep darkness, and who will eventually change the welfare of the nation.

Note: The chapter count includes 3 extra chapters.

170824.description:
Matteo, who was supposed to be just a common villager, is reborn as the grandson of an imperial aristocrat, Lawrence. He spends his days being doted on by his powerful grandfather. With his immense magical powers, Matteo rapidly hatches a dragon egg and tames the dragon, naming it Eva. When his magical abilities are measured, it's revealed that he possesses the strongest magic power ever recorded!

He quickly learns how to use magic, reviving ancient spells and effortlessly drawing the most powerful sword that absorbs magic, making it the strongest. Matteo is also favored by the emperor he meets, but the emperor holds a secret...?

Clever, illustrious, strong, as expected! The life of the most beloved noble, where everything is affirmed, boldly begins!

(Source: MAL News)

Note: The LN began as a web novel on Shousetsuka ni Narou in May 2020, and published in print by Shueisha on February 25, 2021.
synonyms: The Villager Who Was Abandoned, Was Picked Up by an Aristocrat and Awakened a Legendary Divine Skill

title.native: 報われなかった村人A、貴族に拾われて溺愛される上に、実は持っていた伝説級の神スキルも覚醒した
title.romaji: Mukuwarenakatta Murabito A, Kizoku ni Hirowarete Dekiai sareru Ue ni, Jitsu wa Motteita Densetsu-kyuu no Kami Skill mo Kakusei shita

170825.description:
Matteo, who was supposed to be just a common villager, is reborn as the grandson of an imperial aristocrat, Lawrence. He spends his days being doted on by his powerful grandfather. With his immense magical powers, Matteo rapidly hatches a dragon egg and tames the dragon, naming it Eva. When his magical abilities are measured, it's revealed that he possesses the strongest magic power ever recorded!

He quickly learns how to use magic, reviving ancient spells and effortlessly drawing the most powerful sword that absorbs magic, making it the strongest. Matteo is also favored by the emperor he meets, but the emperor holds a secret...?

Clever, illustrious, strong, as expected! The life of the most beloved noble, where everything is affirmed, boldly begins!

(Source: MAL News)
synonyms: The Villager Who Was Abandoned, Was Picked Up by an Aristocrat and Awakened a Legendary Divine Skill

title.native: 報われなかった村人A、貴族に拾われて溺愛される上に、実は持っていた伝説級の神スキルも覚醒した
title.romaji: Mukuwarenakatta Murabito A, Kizoku ni Hirowarete Dekiai sareru Ue ni, Jitsu wa Motteita Densetsu-kyuu no Kami Skill mo Kakusei shita

170826.description:
Onoe and Kaburagi have had some rough patches in their relationship as these opposites navigate their unlikely love—but their bond is paradoxically stronger than ever. In true tabloid style, this compilation of never-before-seen Candy Color Paradox side and bonus stories spills all the juicy details of their romantic life. Includes a 16-page color gallery with exclusive illustrations and comic shorts!

(Source: SuBLime)

title.native: 飴色パラドックス アソートパック

170827.description:
Growing up, Hiro promised Mana that he would marry her when he turned 18, but when he saw his own father being annoyed by his family, he decided he did not want to marry anymore. However, when he enters his senior year of high school, Mana has become a totally unstable girl who pushes him to get married every day!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title.native: 結婚するって言ったよね？
title.romaji: Kekkon suru tte Itta yo ne?

title.native: したたるなら、したためたい。

170830.description:
This is a commercial side story for "Oshibana!" drawn by the author herself.

It is an unofficial R18 manga that creatively (and erotically) fills in the blank that occurred during episode 20 of the main story between pages 19 and 20 (Part 1), after episode 21 (part 2) and after episode 27 (part 3).

Note: Released at Comiket 102, 103 and Comitia 148.

title.native: オシバナ/インターミッション

170831.description:
Seo Han-Jun and Cho Yu-Jae have been best friends since they were young. Han-Jun has secretly been in love with Yu-Jae for a long time but doesn't dare to confess his feelings since he knows they won't be reciprocated. As long as Yu-Jae stays his best friend, that is all that Han-Jun needs to be happy. But as the university entrance exams approach and Yu-Jae becomes more open about his feelings, Han-Jun begins to wonder if it would be okay to reach for that star he thought he could never have.

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes six extra chapters.

170832.description:
No-name actor Jin Ju-Won is taking a bath when he is suddenly sucked into the water. He wakes up to a man calling himself an emperor and Ju-Won a devil. But something seems off about this emperor!

"My life will be in danger if I say it's not true, should I pretend to be a devil?!"

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

170833.description:
A decade ago, Captain U-Jun Kang, an S-tier Esper, saw “Doc” sacrifice himself to save him—no doubt about it. He never even learned Doc’s name. Fast-forward to now, U-Jun’s staring down his new S-Tier Guide, Hui-Won Chae, who’s a dead ringer for the man he thought was gone. Hui-Won draws a complete blank on Captain Kang. Their paths haven’t crossed... or so he thinks. As far as he knows, he was out two months due to an accident. Will they connect the dots, or will this second chance slip away?

(Source: Tapas, edited)

170834.description:
Are first loves overrated, or can a reunion as adults bring back emotions of the past? Yun-Ji and Sae-Bom share a first love story left unfinished, abruptly interrupted by ten years of being apart. Now, as adults, both seem to have moved on from that unfinished chapter of their lives and agree to remain friends and coworkers. However, the surface is not everything there is to be seen, as an unspoken tension lingers between them. Will they merely stay friends, or does destiny have other plans for them?

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)
synonyms: No Dating Allowed in the Office

170835.description:
A second chance to save my husband!
When her happy married life is thrown into turmoil with the death of her husband, Lillian travels back in time to get another shot. But her mission proves challenging when her now-teenage husband turns out to be a little more immature than she was expecting...

(Source: Manta)
synonyms: 夫を大切に育ててみます

170836.description:
Yu Jeong-In is a typical office worker until she meets a sudden end and wakes up mid-kiss… with the male lead of the novel she was reading, Prince Albert! To her dismay, she realizes she is the villainess Rosé Atiers, a lustful maid locked in a tower with Albert by a king set on ruining the prince. Fated to die by his hands, Rosé strikes a deal to help him escape in exchange for money to live comfortably. But will Rosé be able to stick to her plans while living with such a handsome prince?

(Source: Tapas, edited)
synonyms: Living as a Maid in Confinement
ชีวิตของสาวใช้ผู้ถูกจองจำ

title.english: Life as the Maid of the Prisoner Prince

170837.description:
After transmigrating into her favorite novel as Ethel Wallace, she realizes how ridiculous everyone is to fawn over Riena Cassius, her sister-in-law and the original female lead who regressed in the story. Ignored by the family and unable to endure the nonsense any longer, she is determined to divorce her husband and turns toward the marquis, Riena’s future enemy, for help. Will Ethel escape House Cassius? Or will regression trump transmigration? And why does the marquis seem… like a gentleman?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: I Will Divorce the Female Lead's Siscon Brother

title.english: I Will Divorce the Female Lead's Older Brother

170838.description:
A distant echo from a life long-forgotten; shattered shards of an ominous future. When her late mother’s heirloom pendant is broken, Elodie Perdia regains the memories of Ga-Eul Yun, a girl from our world who realizes she’s landed in the body of a villainess from a fantasy novel. In the story, Elodie serves as the dark foil to the virtuous heroine and is destined for an early grave – a dark fate that can perhaps be avoided with Ga-Eul’s knowledge of future events!

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)
synonyms: The Villainous Family Is Against Independence
ครอบครัวตัวร้ายปล่อยฉันไปเถอะ

title.english: My Villainous Family Won't Let Me Be

170839.description:
Did our runt Vanessa Blake encounter another god because yours abandoned you? May we, the lord of evil Belzebuth, tell you something interesting? Most humans seek your god when they end up meeting us. They seem to think their lord will save them and seeing their desperation never fails to make us laugh. That is because their god is just our other half. You may see your many reincarnations as a sign of your god’s disdain, but we feel you are beloved. Thus, we shall give you whatever you desire.

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: เคล็ดวิธีปรนเปรอปีศาจ
悪魔を満足させる方法

170840.description:
An overworked girl strikes gold, waking up as wealthy noblewoman Yvonne Argentrose in a novel. Once a jealous villainess one-sidedly obsessed with the crown prince, now all she wants is a peaceful and opulent life. Still unconvinced of her transformation, her family tries to set her up with the empire's perfect man, Duke Ehels. But when the once uninterested crown prince catches wind of this, he becomes jealous, and drama ensues! Can Yvonne escape the drama and enjoy her new life in peace?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: The Villainess's Match Is Too Perfect
คู่ดูตัวของนางร้ายเพอร์เฟกต์เกินไป

title.english: The Villainess's Blind Date Is Too Perfect

170841.description:
A struggling part-timer suddenly collapses at work and wakes up in the famous novel "Pervin and Stella" as the villainess Irwyne Liliath. To make matters worse, Irwyne's fate in the story is grim as she's condemned to execution for attempting to poison Pervin, the male lead and a highly respected duke. Desperate to survive, Irwyne is determined to win Pervin's heart. But as she grows closer to him, his feelings evolve in unexpected ways. Irwyne now faces an uncertain fate that wasn't written in the novel's pages. Will she be able to rewrite her destiny?

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: อดีตภรรยาของพระเอกหนุ่มจอมคลั่งรัก

title.english: Becoming the Obsessive Male Lead's Ex-Wife

170842.description:
Milaya de Lua is plagued by nightmares about her ancestor, Queen Gloria. But one day, her nightmares become reality when she is attacked by an assassin and wakes up 100 years in the past as the queen herself! Gloria has left her with a message and a mission: she must restore the Wish Stone to turn back time and prevent the kingdom from plunging into despair. Aided by the queen’s diary and a duke who knows her secret, will Milaya be able to save the kingdom and herself?

(Source: Tapas)

170843.description:
Aoi Uehara, a high school boy, recounts the horrifying and bizarre events that befell him at a hospital by the sea.
How everything changed drastically, and how normal daily life came to an end...

(Source: Comic Valkyrie, translated)

title.native: 海辺の病院で彼女と話した幾つかのこと
title.romaji: Umibe no Byouin de Kanojo to Hanashita Ikutsuka no Koto

170844.description:
The development of "Marigold in a Box", a virtual reality game, is stopped after an unfortunate accident. Sun-ah can't help but be sad and disappointed as the manager of the development team. She decides to log on to the game as a farewell... But she can't customize her character? She can't even log out?! She is forced into becoming the protagonist of the game, Cloe Marigold. What choice does she have? She just has to kill herself and reach the 'dead ending' in the game. Then, she'll be free! However, due to interfering NPC characters, she always fails. She almost makes it out once... but she doesn't. Now, there's only one way to get out. She must beat the game.

(Source: PocketComics)
synonyms: 閉じ込められた令嬢は死なせてもらえない
แมริโกลด์ในหีบ

title.english: The Handsome Male Lead Won't Let Me Log Out

170845.description:
Jeong Seo-Hyeon has just about had it with married life. She wants nothing more than to divorce her cheating husband, Ma Gi-Jin, and move on from their loveless marriage. All she needs is his signature on the divorce papers, but… next thing she knows, Gi-Jin has gotten into a major car accident. And to top it all off, it seems he’s forgotten everything about her! Could this be Seo-Hyeon's opportunity to fix things between them? Or will the shards of their broken marriage just end up hurting them both?

(Source: Tapas, edited)
synonyms: ลวงรักคุณสามี

170846.description:
Sunday Battle 8, round 36 one-shot theme: Torture

(Source: Sunday Webry, translated)

Note: Published in Shounen Sunday S 2023-06.
synonyms: The Real Face of the Student Council President

170847.description:
Wang Feng finds himself transmigrated to the Xian Lan Continent. With the help of the powerful Zongmen System, he can summon all sorts of powerful minions to crush all opposition, leading his sect of immortals to unparalleled glory.

(Source: iQIYI, translated)
synonyms: My Sect Has 100 Million Strength Points
The Strongest Sect of All Times

title.romaji: Wo De Zong Men Yi Dian Qiang

170848.description:
Reiji Hashimoto is a smart, ruthless, and cold-hearted boy who hates flirting with girls. He especially despises his classmate Mikage Yakushiji, a clumsy girl who is always making a fool of herself. However, Mikage seems to have an innocent crush on Reiji! This is a unique romantic comedy about the quiet struggle between two people who can't seem to get along!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: 俺はあざといを許さない

170849.description:
I will do anything to protect my innocent little brother!

(Source: Young Animal, translated)
synonyms: The Story of a Sister Who Understands the Woes of Puberty

title.native: 思春期に理解のある姉の話
title.romaji: Shishunki ni Rikai no Aru Ane no Hanashi

170850.description:
During the high school entrance ceremony, the otaku Naruse Arata runs into a girl who looks exactly like "Ririchamu", his favorite girl from the manga Lilygal! His excitement was short-lived, though, because the girl turns out to be just Uchino Hida, a fellow otaku from his junior high school. She has a crush on Naruse-kun, and she had worked hard to remake herself to "look like" Naruse-kun's favorite gal. But Naruse wants a girl who is a gal on the inside, too! Can an otaku girl become a true gal?

(Source: Comic Cune, translated)

title.native: 内田さんは絶対にギャルじゃない！
title.romaji: Uchida-san wa Zettai ni Gal ja Nai!

170851.description:
I am a successful woman in her 30's excelling at her career. But I guess the tables turn when life seems too perfect. It is just my luck that I woke up as Camilla Elchasis, a character in my favorite novel whose life is filled with trouble. After possessing Camilla's body, I first need to get rid of my ridiculous fiancé and his mistress who are fooling around in my house. I must also deal with my half-sister and father who wish to kill me. Meanwhile, why is Duke Caliet so obsessed with me?

"You started it, so I'll finish it."

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

title.native: 転生悪女は我が道を行く
title.romaji: Tensei Akujo wa Waga Michi wo Iku

170852.description:
Akane is 28 years old and works as a director at a web production company. She is busy and fulfilled every day, but her work is all-consuming. To be honest, she doesn't have time for a lover who can heal her.... One day, when her mind and body are at the limit of exhaustion, Fukatsuki, a junior colleague, proposes a relationship in which they simply hug each other! It is true that hugging can reduce people's stress, but is it right to ask a co-worker to do such a thing? But when he puts his arms around her, it feels so natural as she relaxes... A heart-pounding healing love story between a tired girl and a younger guy that starts with a hug!

(Source: Anefure, translated)
synonyms: I'll Hug You From Now on

title.native: 今から俺が抱きしめます

170853.description:
After being reborn as a desolate fire witch and villain destined to die a tragic death, Chersinia creates a plan to avoid her fate by gambling at a casino to become a wealthy recluse. The only problem? She somehow ends up with a slave boy named Ben instead of the money she needs! But much to her surprise, she starts to warm up to Ben, who provides the perfect joy and comfort in her lonely life. Little does she know that Ben has a dark secret that will change her life forever...

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: I Took Care of Him, but He Came Back Obsessed With Me
เลี้ยงมาให้เป็นเด็กดี แต่ดันกลับมาหลงฉันซะงั้น
慎ましく育てたはずの大公に執着されています

170854.description:
One day, Kaiusagi Shirahase, an idol in a popular boy band, is involved in a car accident on his way to a show at the dome arena. The scene changes to a medieval fantasy world. The heroine "Coco Nina" is on her way to the cathedral for her coming-of-age ceremony. Coco is ecstatic as she receives the blessings of the Goddess with the power to protect this world. However, that was when an unfamiliar memory rushes into her mind. I know this… I know this memory… I… I am Kaiusagi Shiranase!

(Source: COMIC Isekai Harem, translated)

title.native: 異世界で聖女になったので国民的アイドルを目指します
title.romaji: Isekai de Seijo ni Natta node Kokumin-teki Idol wo Mezashimasu

170855.description:
Married to work, Estelle reigns supreme as the matriarch of the kingdom of Elandril. However, on her deathbed after decades of selfless service, Estelle takes a final gaze at her most trusted advisor... only to realize she had been betrayed. With her last breath, Estelle vows, "Should I be reborn... never again shall I rule as King." Alas, Estelle wakes up in a mysterious mansion in a peculiar world. And there stands a man who entreats, "There is only one thing you must do for me. Remember me." With those words, King Estelle finds herself reborn as a princess, 150 years after her death. Destined once again for queenship, Estelle journeys - this time - to destroy her marriage to the kingdom.

(Source: PocketComics)
synonyms: The Betrayed Queen Is Devoted to by the Beautiful Baron

title.native: 裏切られた女王は、麗しの男爵に尽くされる
title.romaji: Uragirareta Joou wa, Uruwashi no Danshaku ni Tsukusareru

170856.description:
The fragile but cheeky Laviette is not here to save the plot of the novel she transmigrated into. Instead, her goal is to escape her fate of a short life through her best friend, Ahckard, and his healing powers. The novel says he'll fall for her brother, so she sees him as just a friend. However, it doesn't seem like Ahckard plans to follow the original plot either. Will Laviette have to look elsewhere for her happy ending, or will she realize that what she needed has been beside her all along?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: ช่วยทะนุถนอมเพื่อนคนนี้หน่อยนะ

170857.description:
In a twist of fate, a girl wakes up as Lynzelle, twin to her favorite novel's dying female lead, Lykke. To secure Lykke's happiness, she volunteers to wed the fearsome prince, Hernan, in her sister's stead. But hold on... The scary prince turns out to be super cute, sparking unforeseen feelings! Everything seems perfect until Lynzelle's health mysteriously deteriorates more than Lykke's, and the story takes an unexpected turn. Is this cute twin tale hiding more secrets than meets the eye?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: I Became the Sister of the Time-Limited Heroine

title.english: I Became the Dying Female Lead's Sister

170858.description:
After meeting her death, Thalia is reborn as the female protagonist’s older sister, a character that never existed in the novel she wrote in her past life. She tries hard to get attached to the world inside the novel, but she gets caught up in the thought that everything is just a mere creation of her own.

“Please make Tilly love me.”

Aegis, who was supposed to fall in love with Thalia's younger sister, makes a wish to God on his coming-of-age birthday.

Will Thalia be able to love Aegis?"

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Note:
- Includes eight extra chapters.
- First released in English, with the initial eligible release in Japanese followed by Korean, making it a manga by our standards.
synonyms: 我成了原著中不存在的角色
Personnage improvisé dans mon propre univers
轉生後的角色連原作者的我都不認識
เมื่อฉันกลายเป็นตัวละครที่ไม่มีในนิยาย!

title.english: Reborn as a Character That Never Existed
title.native: 原作者なのに身に覚えのないキャラに転生しました
title.romaji: Gensakushana noni Mi ni Oboenonai Chara ni Tenseishimashita

170859.description:
Happy to die for the sake of her friends, Aryn the sorcerer succumbs to the poisonous breath of the evil dragon Kuntern. 80 years later, through the divine powers of The World Tree and her former adventuring companion Zephyr, Aryn finds herself reborn. Upon her awakening, she learns that her childhood best friend, Elkinas Pontiac, went insane after her death. Once the leader of their expedition, El is now a tyrant ruler, raising a child hatched from Kuntern’s egg. Will Aryn be able to save him?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: The Hero Went Crazy Even Though I'm the One Who Died
我的犧牲與勇士的瘋狂
คนตายคือฉัน แต่ท่านนักรบดันเป็นบ้า

title.english: I'm the One Who Died, but the Hero Went Crazy
title.native: 죽은 건 난데 용사님이 미쳐 버렸다
title.romaji: Jugeun Geon Nande Yongsanimi Michyeo Beoryeotda

170860.description:
Yana Jeong, a typical girl, runs into a strange man who’s out of breath during one of her part-time jobs. Little did she know that this was Kai Shim, the son of the CEO of a large jewelry corporation called Inoroo, who also happens to be a merman. Yana coincidentally runs in Kai again when she ends up working as a waitress at his birthday party, where a series of accidents lead to the two of them meeting each other again. Will Yana be able to keep up with these unexpected events happening one after another?

(Source: WEBTOON)

170862.description: Nobara Nonaka's autobiographical manga about her daily life with her pet siamese cat, Chiko.

170863.description:
"Marry me, Yukio. Be my wife, on this bed of flowers."

Yukio is a human apothecary, living in the world of the youkai. One day, her ex-husband, the eight-tailed white fox Shiratsuki, shows up at her doorstep and asked her to get back together with him…? What? They had divorced after only a few months into an arranged marriage, without any chance to date or getting to know each other…

An fantasy romance between an apothecary girl and a great kitsune lord.

(Source: Iris, translated)

170864.description:
U-Geon has always been fascinated with amusement parks, but his work is miserable, getting looked down on by his childhood friend, Cho-I, every day. However, his life changes when he gets his hands on a magical tarot card that gives him the power to control any girl he wants.

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

170865.description:
There's no such thing as work-life balance for poor Nayul, thanks to her evil boss, Sijin. Not only does he make her work overtime constantly, but she's also dumped by her boyfriend because of it. Fed up with Sijin's demonic ways, Nayul storms to his office to complain... and finds him jerking off! Though the sight is initially grotesque, Nayul finds herself oddly turned on. Somehow, she ends up banging her boss on his desk, which leads to an irritating yet steamy colleagues-with-benefits relationship. But how long can Nayul keep this shameful secret from her prying ex and gossipy coworkers?

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: I Say Please Be Quiet and Take Off Your "Something"

170866.description:
Water polo is said to be the most physically demanding of all the sports. Having just transferred to a new school in Tokyo, Shinano Chikuma, who is 185 centimeters tall, is invited by Katsura Yamashiro, who is 191 centimeters tall, to try out for the water polo club and eventually reluctantly decides to join…!

(Source: Sunday Webry, translated)

170867.description:
Very young stepmother and older sisters. The lustful secrets of the girls and their deceased father. He inherits his father’s woman and becomes the new master.

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)
synonyms: The USB Left by My Father

170868.description:
A place silenced by death and stillness. The survival on an enigmatic island begins.

(Source: Tapas)

170869.description:
Hong Woomi has always loved Park Euijun all her life. But when she finally confesses to him, he flat-out rejects her because they practically grew up together. Heartbroken, Woomi tries to keep away from Euijun at their company, only to end up working with him on the same project. Little does she know, he added her to his team because he's been secretly in love with her all along! With Woomi trying to get over him now, will Euijun successfully tempt her to fall for him again?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: 誘惑しないで、お兄さん

170870.description:
Born and raised on a diet of peaches, a do-myeong named Seol-Won was destined to become a courtesan of the highest class, an exquisite creation known as a jade feet. But when his incomplete body is deemed defective and dangerous, he’s cast aside as a failed product, discarded like broken porcelain.

Before he can be sold off cheaply, a mysterious attack leaves him unconscious. When he wakes, he learns he’s already been bought, for a staggering sum, by an unknown master. His search for answers leads him to Dream Palace, a sprawling casino ruled by the enigmatic Jay, a man whose beauty and power are matched only by his madness.

Cursed by a succubus, Jay suffers from uncontrollable fits of desire and delirium. The only cure, it seems, lies in the stray do-myeong, the discarded creation who may now hold the key to both salvation and ruin.

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: 桃源奇譚〜桃を食む少年〜

170871.description:
The dungeons are a wild place where anything can happen, and they need the best of the best to keep them in check. So when widespread distribution of the aphrodisia-inducing Cherry Bombs begins to run rampant, there is only one man for the job. Captain of Special Forces Team 1, Jeon Jinwoo is known for having the face of a supermodel and the mouth of a sailor…but in order to take down this fruity operation, he’s going to need assemble a team. With the help of his unpredictable subordinate Yoo Haesung and former lover Cha Sera, Jinwoo and squad will have to undergo unthinkable trials and tribulations to restore order to the wild word of the dungeons.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Chapter count includes 4 extras.
synonyms: ダンジョンでBLなんて⁉︎〜モンスターからイケメン救出〜
ดันเจี้ยนนี้มี BL ด้วยเหรอ?!

170872.description:
Welcome to planet Goo, home of the Suima Clan, tall beings that need 23 hours of sleep a day or they become weak.

Unfortunately, Goo's ruler, Prince Brillian, has been overcome with a mysterious insomniatic illness! The sexually robust and dazzlingly handsome General Ketsukarl must collect 1000 people's worth of 'Sleepy Sleep' energy to return the prince to his normal sleeping patterns!

Join General Ketsukarl on his frantic, crazy search in this hilariously sexy(?) comedy!

(Source: Manga Reborn)

Note: The digital version splits the original chapters, so the chapter count differs.

title.native: 怒濤の最狂戦士 睡魔くん

170873.description:
Daehwa Kim is a piano prodigy who drops out of a prestigious performing arts high school due to a lack of passion. Just when he finally discovers his love for the piano at 30, he gets into a fatal accident, only to wake up as a high school student again! Can he turn his fate around this time?

(Source: Manta)
synonyms: ピアノの天才の高校生活

170874.description:
Ridel Cross is simply the fourth daughter of an ordinary knight, or at least, she was until her 18th birthday when she awakened her barrier magic skills. When the emperor learned of her magic skills, he summoned her to work for him. Sadly, “work” in the emperor’s definition meant being locked up in a magic tower to be treated worse than a slave and used as a tool.

One day, after 10 long years of misery, Ridel cries herself to sleep while rueing the day she revealed her barrier magic. She silently wishes that she could go back to her 18th birthday and change her life. Magically, this wish does come true and Ridel wakes up back at home on the day of her 18th birthday. Upon realizing that she had returned to the past, she vows to live a life free of magic and becomes a maid at a count’s estate.

Unfortunately, her dream of living a peaceful life comes crashing down when she sees the estate’s butler, Graham, who has the exact same facial features as the emperor in her previous life. Is she doomed to never escape the grasp of the emperor, or is this just some crazy coincidence?

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: 伯爵令嬢の恋人を誘惑せよ

170875.description:
For Nam Juho, life as a repeat student aiming for med school is supposed to be simple: study, eat convenience store kimbap, and sleep, preferably in that order. But peace is impossible when Yeo Jiwoo, his eccentric classmate from the same cram school, suddenly decides he’s her new favorite target. From stolen pens and playful pranks to unsolicited “study motivation,” Jiwoo seems determined to turn Juho’s quiet, disciplined life into a daily comedy of chaos. He swears she’s doing it just to annoy him… but why does his heart race every time she flashes that mischievous smile? Between mock exams, caffeine highs, and emotional confusion, Juho finds himself stuck in the most distracting kind of competition—a love-hate study war that’s way harder than any entrance test. Who knew the toughest subject in cram school would be romance?

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: The Student, The Witch, and The Academy

170876.description:
Do Shiyoon was the leader of a struggling K-pop boy band when he tragically died in a car accident... or so he thought! Miraculously, he wakes up in his 17-year-old body and realizes that he's gone back in time to before he debuted as an idol. Now, he is determined to make it big in K-pop. As he prepares for his re-debut, he has to avoid the pitfalls of his first life while gathering four like-minded and talented idol trainees to make a new boy band, the likes of which K-pop has never seen!

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: The Second Life of an All-Rounder Idol
万能アイドルは人生2回目

170877.description:
Seok is a jovial manservant for a noble family. One day, while out on an errand, he gets a glimpse of a mysterious and alluring performer that has arrived at the market. But a fleeting look won’t suffice. He can’t get his mind off of this enigmatic figure. Will he ever see them again?

As fate would have it, their paths will certainly cross again. But the complications of their lives and the entanglements of their relationships will mean that things will unfold in ways that are anything but easy. Who will risk it all and dive deep into the blue for a chance at love?

(Source: Lezhin US)

170878.description:
It's not over until it's over! A variety of episodes that will keep you on your guard until the end. A full-scale horror thriller that goes beyond your imagination is coming!

(Source: Naver, translated)

170879.description:
As the last of the divine beasts who protected the land, Lionel Milliard was coveted by women for his power and influence. But after an accident with an ancient relic binds him to an inn worker named Hanna, he finally finds one woman with no interest in him! Lionel, intrigued by Hanna's rejection, convinces her to go on a journey with him to free them of the relic's power. Hanna reluctantly agrees, but will she be able to fend off Lionel's advances, or will this beast devour yet another woman?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes 11 extra chapters.
synonyms: 超個人主義的な恋愛〜神獣との恋愛事情〜
和猛虎大人的恋爱旅行

170880.description:
Sakihara-san is the hottest gal in school, and Miyabe-kun is the overly serious member of the school discipline committee. Everyone loves Sakihara-san, but for some reason, her charm doesn't seem to work on Miyabe! The frustrated Sakihara will try anything to try and seduce him...? A youthful love comedy about falling in love with a gal!

(Source: Comic Owl, translated)

title.native: 誘惑しないで！咲原さん

170882.description:
A young man who is popular with the girls has an unpopular older brother. It's not that he dislikes his brother, but for some reason he feels particularly annoyed by the fact that his brother is unpopular.

(Source: Harta Alternative, translated)

170883.description:
Sharon is a young girl who aspires to be a pianist, and Silas is a boy who is a prodigy at the piano. The two become close and are attracted to each other through their music, but they are unable to be honest with their feelings due to trivial matters...

Also includes the side story Kashinoki Monogatari, about a boy obsessed with an oak tree that is said to make wishes come true.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

170884.description:
Here, try this sword. Jun-Seo Shin is a master weapon creator doing menial jobs to keep a low profile in a world teeming with monster dungeons. But his habit of lending weapons to those in need exposes him to mega guilds and covert figures out to kill budding heroes from his past life. Can Jun-Seo craft his way out of trouble and uncover the conspiracy that followed him to this life?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Note: Includes one prologue.

title.romaji: Hokuto to Iu Na no Hito

170886.description:
Chihiro, who quit his previous band due to a failed love affair, has been a vocalist in his current band for two years after being invited by Mikumo. Chihiro has been asked to sing a love song many times, but for some reason he has always refused. In their final year of college, job hunting started to get them busy, and before the band part their ways, Mikumo confesses how much he loves Chihiro's voice and asks him to rethink the idea of singing a love song for the last time.

(Source: Gentosha Comics, translated)

Note: An extra chapter is included.

title.native: ラブソングが歌えない

170887.description:
After being abused, tortured, and exploited by her best friend Lavienne for 14 lifetimes, Saint Dinah swears to get revenge. And luckily for her, she manages to capture the attention of Archduke Tersia, who adopts and renames her "Esther" to honor his late wife's wishes. With her new status and knowledge of Lavienne's true nature, Esther embarks on the long journey toward vengeance. But will she succeed? Or will her 15th life meet its demise due to Lavienne's greed?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: A Saint Who Was Adopted by the Grand Duke
นักบุญหญิงผู้ถูกตระกูลแกรนด์ดยุกรับเลี้ยง

170888.description:
"I will serve you, my lady." A kiss on the back of her hand is the mark of his servitude. These two dreamboats would make anyone envious. A heart-pounding master/student love story begins at the academy!

(Source: INKR)

title.english: Unattainable Two: A Master & Servant School Love Story
title.native: 高嶺の花ふたり、学園主従カンケイ
title.romaji: Takane no Hana Futari, Gakuen Shujuu Kankei

170889.description: Tokizou realizes he’s getting overweight. He worries if it stays like this, he’ll be dumped!

title.native: 芝と時造 ダイエット編

170894.description:
The world was embroiled in a death game involving individuals from ages 15 to 29. Thrown into a game devoid of empathy and compassion, Min Ryu had no choice but to fight for his survival. For the 99th time, he finally made it to the end of the game. Standing alone in front of the final boss’s chamber, Min Ryu was greeted with betrayal as the system killed him for not having four more players with him. On his 100th and final attempt, can Min Ryu find the help he needs to end this ruthless game?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: The 100th Regression of the Max-Level Player
การกลับมาครั้งที่ 100 ของผู้เล่นเลเวลแม็กซ์

title.english: The 100th Regression of the Max-Level Player

170895.description:
For all her life, poor Lueri has been hanging by a thread, and the situation doesn't get any better when she is forced into an unwelcome marriage. But by miracle or design, a magical invitation presents her with a way of escaping her loveless life -- by joining the empire’s Jewel Box. There, among the brilliant gemstones, she finds help in the unlikeliest of places, friends from the unlikeliest of crowds, and perhaps, something she’s been desperately yearning for until now -- true love.

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: เจ้าสาวอัคนีดำ

170896.description:
Jin-Guk tries to find the criminals of a series of copycat murders! The killer's face is vaguely in his memory!

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

170897.description:
Chiyu Hitsuji is a girl who is having trouble making friends in high school. One day, she is summoned by a classmate, Amatsuka, who is surrounded by dark rumors. Determined to try to meet new people, Chiyu shows up, where Amatsuka-kun unexpectedly asks her for help… A love comedy unfolds between Chiyu, who just wants to live a peaceful life, and Amatsuka, who is troubled by a certain problem.

(Source: Natalie, translated)
170897.hashtag: #ねんねんころりよ天使くん

title.native: ねんねんころりよ天使くん

170898.description:
On the isolated Sun Moon Island, the powerful monster tribe hunted the beast tribe. The beast tribe remained strong and united to fight for their survival against the monsters, in a war that has lasted for more than a hundred years. The beast tribe, tired of being beaten down in this unequal struggle, slowly gathered a group of heroes into an organization known as the "Zodiacs"…

(Source: TAPIR, translated)

170899.description:
Want to feel the wind? Witches, motorcycles, and romance! Sarah, the last witch in the world, follows motorcycles all over the world on her broomstick to find her lost father. In her long journey through time and space, she runs with the wind, accompanied by the many motorcyclists she meets along the way.

(Source: yomoyo)

170900.description:
During the sect's recruiting event, Qin Tian, the laziest master in the sect, somehow got himself a disciple in An Miaoling, who is the reincarnation of the empress. After An Miaoling joins the sect, she soon discovers that the so-called useless Qin Tian is merely putting up an act. Now the reincarnated empress is extremely curious about her master's true abilities.

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: My Apprentice Is Actually the Empress

title.romaji: Wo De Tudi Ju Ran Shi Nüdi

170901.description:
He was just a childhood friend, like a cute little brother.
But now, six years later, he is……
Even before we started dating, and now that we are going out, I can still feel my heart getting all flustered.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Note: Originally self-published, was then licensed by Kadokawa for commercial release.
synonyms: A Two-Year Age Gap Between Childhood Friends
Childhood Friend with a Two-Year Age Difference

170902.description:
Hidehiro Tanimura, second-year high school student. His mother has passed away, his father has become a shut-in, and his little sister is the only one who can soothe his soul... On the surface, life seems to be happy, but behind the scenes, another "monster" has come to his home. She's cute and naughty but obedient to her desires. Hidehiro's life with the extremely dangerous female teacher Saara-sensei has begun...!!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

Chemistry so perfect... it's addictive!

170907.description:
One day, Elise suddenly found that she had been reincarnated into the world of an Otome game as a villainess. As per the trope, Elise's engagement with the prince got broken off, but... she doesn't care! Now that she has memories from her previous life, she wants to experiment with cooking cheats, domestic affairs cheats, and all sorts of things. With the support of her truly unique family, she quickly doles out punishment to idiots, and makes food porn happen with "that dish," the likes of which has never been seen before in an Otome game world...?! Enjoy the A laugh-out-loud fantasy by an unprecedented out-of-this-world villainess!

(Source: Alpha Manga)

ランブルローズ4コマバトルロイヤル

Included Stories:

170918.description:
After graduating from high school in the United States, Eric finally returns to Japan to see his childhood friend, Nao. It has been 13 years since he left. Nao is growing up and must be beautiful now. Eric has been secretly longs for her. But when he calls at Nao's house, the person who answers the door is a bearded, frowning man who is wearing nothing but a pair of underpants. To Eric's astonishment, he is Nao! Nao is a man! Eric was so young at the time that he thought Nao was a girl and he has been mistaken for such a long time. But same as before, Nao is very kind and Eric still feels that he likes him. Nao suggests to Eric that he stays in his house instead of using hotels during his whole stay in Japan. Eric is happy to stay but in the middle of the night, woken by noises, he finds Nao is taking a male customer and having sex! Eric is so shocked and next morning, he offers Nao a credit card and says, “Just don't have sex with strangers anymore"...

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: My Darling is a Foreign Crybaby
title.native: ダーリンは泣き虫外国人

170919.description:
Ao Fujieda is a high school boy who doesn't fit at school.
He meets a girl at the local library where he goes after school.
A cheerful, carefree, and smiling girl who seems like his complete opposite.
Their encounter will eventually turn into "love."

(Source: MangaUP, translated)

170920.description:
Nanami is a 26-year-old single office lady on her way home from working late, trying to catch the last train, when she witnesses two guys get into a fight. She ends up helping to take care of Souta, a college student who got beat up in the fight. Although he has a handsome face, he is a womanizer, and on that same night, he rolls into Nanami's house and starts to......!?

"You can treat me like kind of a pet."

A slightly dangerous cohabitation romantic comedy between an experienced college boy and an older office lady who is a zero at love!

(Source: LINE Manga, translated)

Note: includes seven extra chapters
synonyms: I Can't Keep It in My House

170921.description: Romi is the princess of the Emotions Kingdom, and has been sent to Earth to capture rogue creatures called Teeniepings who have escaped.
synonyms: Catch! Teenieping: Everyday's a Transformation Day

title.native: キャッチ！ティニピン まいにちが変身day
title.romaji: Catch! Tinipin Mai ni chi ga Henshin day

170922.description:
Novelist Yui Tsubakiyama, winner of a writer's award at the young age of 18, is in a slump. He writes stories vividly depicting young love, and has been nicknamed the heartbroken novelist. He has been writing novels based on his own relationships, but does not expect to meet anyone new... That's when he meets Chiaki, a refreshingly handsome businessman from out of town, who asks him for directions. An everlasting love that doesn't end in heartbreak between a younger businessman and a heartbroken novelist!

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Chapter count includes one volume bonus chapter.

title.english: The Heartbroken Novelist's Tale Of Love

170923.description:
Jun Xiaoyao transmigrated into a fantastical world and into the body of the scion of a prominent clan, which will give him powerful backers and incredible talent. He is also given the Login System, which provided him with a fully-formed ancient sacred body right from the start. With the help of his System, he will march to the pinnacle of this world!

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: Scoring the Sacred Body of the Ancients from the Get-go
Start by signing in and obtaining the Ancient Divine Body

170924.description:
Kite, a court magician, has been putting up wards to protect the country in place of the saint. However, as soon as the crown prince's favored lady is chosen as the next saint, Kite is cursed to only be able to use dark magic and banished from the country. He is also forced to fight off a dragon that was accidentally summoned by the government... He has no choice but to start living as a hermit deep in the forest, along with the dragon he defeated...

(Source: FireCross, translated)
synonyms: The Black Sage That Manipulates Shadows. Or How I Was Exiled After They Were Done with Me Being the Stand-In for the Saint and Then I Got a Curse That Gave Me a Dark Attribute Magical Power That Turned Out to Be a Cheat-Like All-Purpose Magic.
Kuro no Kenja wa Kage wo Oru: Seijo Dairi wa Mou Youzumi dato Tsuihou sareta ga, Kakerareta Noroi "Yami Zokusei" wa Bannou no Cheat Mahou Datta

title.native: 黒の賢者は影を織る ～聖女代理はもう用済みだと追放されたが、かけられた呪い【闇属性】は万能のチート魔法だった～
title.romaji: Kuro no Kenja wa Kage wo Oru: Seijo Dairi wa Mou Youzumi dato Tsuihousareta ga, Kakerareta Noroi "Yami Zokusei" wa Bannou no Cheat Mahou Datta

170925.description:
Myora is an aspiring actor who keeps failing auditions. With his last hope, he goes without an appointment to the hotel where a foreign film company executive is supposed to be staying. At the luxury hotel, he runs into Ajit, a man as beautiful as a bronze statue, surrounded by a number of retainers and is clad in expensive jewellery! He is the Maharaja who runs the film company. An intense love affair between a brilliant maharajah and a young Japanese man! A beautifully illustrated story!

(Source: BexBoy Comics, translated)

170926.description:
An cute master-servant yuri comedy between an innocent master and a mad dog JK!

Mayuki, an innocent and petite high school girl, has a loyal follower "Satou-san," who is as fierce as any delinquent in a fight… Mayuki leads Satou-san around school with a leash and collar, and they don't mind the strange looks from the people round them! A yuri comedy depicting the relationship between these two sweethearts at school!

(Source: Comic Cune, translated)

title.native: 下僕ちゃんと主ちゃんの日常～主のためなら何でもします～
title.romaji: Geboku-chan to Aruji-chan no Nichijou: Aruji no Tamenara Nandemo Shimasu

170927.description:
Superhumans are springing up all over the world. Instead of making human life easier, they unleash hell on Earth. To maintain order, the Department of Superhuman Defense is born. Superhumans are being exploited, tyrannized, and hunted down. It's a world in which superhumans don't belong.

(Source: WebComics)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: A World Where Only the Super-Powered Are Harmed

title.native: 只有超能力者受伤害的世界
title.romaji: Zhi You Chaonengli Zhe Shou Shanghai De Shijie

170929.description:
After defying death's grip, Yu Lin awakens the "Divine Tycoon System," which grants him daily cash payouts. But there's a catch: the money is unusable Nether Tokens. Years later, he gets chosen as one of the lucky few to beta-test Global Menace, a horror game where only the best and strongest can survive. While others are frantically appeasing the fierce spirits, Yu Lin recruits loyal ghost followers with his Tycoon spending. Looks like having money is all you need to rule the underworld!

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: 全球惊悚：开局万亿冥币
It All Starts With Trillions Of Nether Currency

title.native: 全球惊悚：开局万亿冥币
