170930.description: Follow the daily life, and the family life, of an ordinary mangaka.

title.native: 没有漫画 没有人生

170931.description:
Recently, the high school girl Waka has been having frequent dreams about a woman named Wakako and a man named Sho-san. In the dream, Wakako says to Sho-San, "I will always find you, wherever you are." One day, Waka crosses paths with Shogo, a boy who looks exactly like Sho-san!? She falls in love again with her lover from a past life!? A reincarnation love comedy.

(Source: Comic Tanto, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes a volume-bonus chapter.

title.native: 前世からお慕い申し上げます！

170932.description:
The Kingdom of Malkido has been locked in conflict with magical beasts. Two sisters, "Laura" and "Leila" lived there in harmony. Until one day when the older sister Leila was chosen as the "saint," an important position in the kingdom. Court intrigue caused fissures in their relationship. Villainous aristocrats tore the sisters apart. Now Laura will set out to get her beloved sister back, in this epic tale of revenge!

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)
synonyms: Laura, the Princess of Revenge: I No Longer Need This Country After They Sacrificed My Sister

title.native: 復讐姫ローラ～お姉様を生贄にしたこの国はもう要らない～
title.romaji: Fukushuuki Laura: Onee-sama wo Ikenie ni Shita Kono Kuni wa Mou Iranai

170933.description:
His blunt and unfriendly attitude hides a secret?

(Source: Margaret, translated)

170934.description:
“Hey, Atsuko…why did you kill my husband?”

Atsuko and Yuri were classmates in high school, but that’s about as close as they’ve ever been. They rarely spoke, never hung out, and belonged to completely different social circles—they couldn’t have been more different. Fifteen years after graduation, they meet once again at a class reunion…and both of their lives are changed forever. Two women. One dead husband. An irreversible act and a desperate escape. But are they headed for ruin…or redemption?

(Source: MANGA MILLION)

title.native: 腐女子になって四半世紀経つとこうなる～底～懐古編
title.romaji: Fujoshi ni Natte Shihanseiki Tatsuto Kounaru: Soko - Kaiko Hen

170939.description:
When I was eighteen years old, I thought that love is the courage to fight against the whole world for you. At the age of twenty-five, I discovered that love gives you the confidence to embrace the whole world. If you say that young love is as unpredictable as the wind, then I would like to spend the rest of my life in your arms.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)
synonyms: For the Rest of My Life

170940.description:
The new Bible for cat lovers. Two cats (Chiko and Ryu), twice the effort, four times the cuteness, and infinite happiness!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

170941.description:
Master Yu Yuan's neverending search for his beloved apprentice continues! Now that he's ascended to immortality, does that make fixing the The Bug even more difficult?

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.native: 我家徒弟又挂了 第二季

170943.description:
"Shimizu-san, you dyed your hair black."
"Ah, yeah."
"Why did you dye it all of a sudden?"
"Because…yesterday…"

Shimizu-san, the delinquent JK who sits next to me with her newly-dyed hair, gradually lowered her voice, slightly blushed, and laid her face down on the desk.

After that, when I, Daiki Hondo, talked with my friend about how I wanted be with a girl who can cook, the next day I ended up partnered with Shimizu-san in cooking class, even though she used to always skip class. When I mentioned that I wished I could try a girl's hand-made cooking, for some reason she brought two bentos to lunch the next day and shared one with me…

(Source: Sneaker Bunko, translated)
synonyms: The Delinquent Shimizu-san Sitting Next to Me Has Dyed Her Hair Black

title.native: 隣の席のヤンキー清水さんが髪を黒く染めてきた
title.romaji: Tonari no Seki no Yankee Shimizu-san ga Kami wo Kuroku Sometekita

170945.description:
The Rat, the Ox, the Tiger, the Rabbit, the Dragon, the Snake, the Horse, the Goat, the Monkey, the Rooster, the Dog, and the Pig. These twelve tribes, each boasting their own special powers, battled for hegemony over the nation until the Emperor, tired of these endless wars, instead proposed a "festival"—5v5 proxy battles for which each tribe must send a "beastblade" to fight on their behalf. Princess Ibusuki of the Rabbit tribe, the weakest clan of all, was searching for her own champion to whom she could entrust the fate of her people when she came upon Hijimaru of the legendary Lion tribe. Little did she know that this encounter would mark the beginning of something far greater! Welcome to the fantastical tale of the zodiac struggle!

(Source: K MANGA)

synonyms: A Caring Mother Fucked By Her Cunning Son

title.native: 世話焼きママ、息子にハメられる。

170947.description: 4-koma series based on the Ace Attorney cast, spreading over both trilogies and the Investigations and The Great Ace Attorney duology spin-offs. Originally distributed via the Gyakuten Tsuushin e-mail magazine, can be found and read for free on the official Ace Attorney Japanese website.

170948.description:
Tyler is an adventurer who, for some reason, does not possess the magical attribute that everyone else has. He is abandoned in the depths of the dungeon by the party leader for his lack of magic. However, while trying to save his childhood friend Ariana, who stayed behind with him, his hidden powers are awakened! It turns out that he has an unprecedented ability to use magic of all attributes. After escaping the dungeon, Tyler hears that there is a medicinal herb that can cure his sister's illness, and he forms a new party with the goal of challenging the super-advanced dungeon. Living a fun and humble adventurer's life with his reliable friends!

(Source: Alphapolis, translated)

title.native: えっ、能力なしでパーティ追放された俺が全属性魔法使い！？　～最強のオールラウンダー目指して謙虚に頑張ります～
title.romaji: Ee, Nouryoku Nashi de Party Tsuihou Sareta Ore ga Zenzokusei Mahoutsukai!?: Saikyou no All-Rounder Mezashite Kenkyo ni Ganbarimasu

170949.description:
Born in the wilderness, and raised by wolves, young Luke is adopted by a warm-hearted priest who introduces him to a new family and a life beyond survival. But the peace is shattered when the Vikings attack. Driven by vengeance he becomes a relentless warrior, carving a blood soaked path towards those who wronged him.

(Source: Titan Manga)

170951.description:
Childhood rivals Dante and Gino are leading candidates within their Italian mafia famiglia, each determined to claim the seat of the next Don.

19xx Italy. The Gardino Famiglia, a powerful mafia organization that controls the city’s ports, is in the midst of selecting its next don. Two strong candidates stand in opposition: Capo Gino, leader of the Pureblood Faction who respects tradition, and Capo Dante, leader of the Radical Faction who envisions a progressive new era. Since childhood, Dante’s had a habit of messing with Gino, who sees him as nothing more than an annoying rival. That is, until Dante discovers Gino’s biggest secret. Now, with the upper hand, what will Dante demand in return for his silence?

(Source: KUMA)
synonyms: The Betrayer Sings a Love Song

title.native: 裏切り者のラブソング

170952.description:
The Hinokami and Mizunagi families have been at odds with each other for many years, and there is an ironclad rule that they must never love anyone from the other side. Juri, the daughter of the Hinokami family, has made up her mind that she will marry the man of her parents' choice for the sake of her family. One day, Juri goes out and is suddenly kissed by a man. It turns out that man is a member of the Mizunagi clan… This is a modern version of Romeo and Juliet as depicted by Watanabe.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: いいから黙ってキスをして
title.romaji: Ii kara Damatte Kiss wo Shite

170954.description:
Humanity has lost. By the end of World War Three, the R-virus has decimated 80% of the world’s population. To make matters worse, the virus transforms the infected into mindless monsters who crave human flesh, with some evolving into powerful beings with special powers called “Rayers”. The last remaining human settlements live in fear, their survival entirely dependent on the R-X, teenagers who have gained special abilities themselves through contact with Rayers. Wielding lethal weapons and supernatural abilities, the R-X fights to defend what little hope humanity has left.

(Source: WEBTOON)

170955.description:
Recently divorced gay company man, Narumi, visits a cafe he used to be a regular at prior to his marriage. There, cafe employee Kida confesses that he has feelings for Narumi, having been comforted by Narumi's words four years ago. Due to past trauma, Narumi has become timid in love, but when Kida proposes, "Won't you try falling in love with me?" their love trial begins!

An obedient younger doggy-type x innocent alpha's bittersweet, too cute, pure love begins!

(Source: Frontier Works, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: オレと恋愛してみませんか
title.romaji: Ore to Renai Shite Mimasen ka

170956.description:
Steel Emperor Hyeonuk Lee, the last savior of humanity, has died. The place he returned to in order to change the future is... the military?!! Why here of all places?! Corporal Hyeonuk Lee's steel eating show begins as he rapidly grows to get revenge!

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: เพลเยอร์นักกินเหล็ก

170957.description: For failing to give the rabbit's liver to the Dragon King, a snapping turtle, Yu Han-Byeol, was punished by repeated reincarnation with memories of her previous life. In order to escape the endless cycle of reincarnation, she has to accomplish her unfinished duties, but...instead of stealing the rabbit's liver, it's a modern version of The Tale of the Rabbit, where the rabbit's heart is stolen!
synonyms: I've Been Looking for a Thousand Years

170958.description:
Natsukawa, a member of the beautification committee, often finds her gaze lingering on her schoolmate Aihara. One fateful day off, she spots Aihara walking alongside another girl... As summer’s heat stirs the air, a delicate tale of first love begins to take shape...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

170959.description:
Mikitoamon, who made a spectacular debut with the previous work "One more time after the Rain", has released the long-awaited second work collection! In addition to the lyrical works like the first and second parts, it is a book where you can enjoy a variety of erotic works, including challenging works such as "Boku wa Kimi no Inu" and "Shojo Collection".

(Source: cmoa, translated)

1-2. Marude Rokugatsu no Kohan wo Fukukaze no You ni (まるで六月の湖畔を吹く風のように)
3. Boku wa Kimi no Inu (僕は君の犬)
4-5. Shoujo Collection (少女コレクション)
6. NNL ~Nama Naka Kyokashou~ (NNL~生ナカ許可証~)
7-8. RE: Ame to Hikari (RE:雨とひかり)
9. Sukizuki Daisuki Chou ×2 Aishiteru (好き好き大好き超×2愛してる)

170964.description:
A collection of stories:

1. Giniro no Romance (銀色のロマンス)
2. Itoshi Kimi e no Serenade (いとし君へのセレナーデ)
3. Hinata e Hikage e no Romance (日なたへ日かげへのロマンス)
4. Ooeyama Kaden (大江山花伝)


Note: Also contains a three part illustrated short story series titled Gozo no Ohanashi (ごぞのおはなし)

title.native: 日なたへ日かげへのロマンス
title.romaji: Hinata e Hikage e no Romance

170965.description:
Kotone is a girl who has romantic notions about "unrequited love." When she enters high school, she is attracted to Ichitani, a mischievous boy in her class. Kotone joins the basketball club to enjoy her "unrequited love" with him, but her feelings grow...

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

170966.description:
Eunho, the strongest in the yokai realm!
He gained the chance to become a human being after losing the woman he loved and killing countless yokai.
After passing the gate of reincarnation by accumulating merit for a thousand years to abandon his immortal body…

He became a human being, held a sword, and learned martial arts for the first time.
But this is very… easy?

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

170967.description:
Moritaka Iriya is a very unusual girl who is starting high school this year. What is her secret...? Iriya is in love with Ametsuki-senpai, who is also the student council president, and she joins the Reading Club so that she can look like a normal girl as much as possible. However, during club time, she finds Ametsuki-senpai stuck doing chores and goes to the judo club to protest...!
:
synonyms: 我が愛しのジャンキィタウン
ジャンキィタウンは平和を愛す

170968.description:
Shanley is a young girl living in the forest, in a country where the legend of dragons is still told. While every child in the village yearns to be the legendary hero, she is more sympathetic to the "dragon." When she comes into contact with enemies for the first time, her inner destiny awakens. An epic fantasy that brings the legend of dragons and heroes to life!

(Source: Young Animal ZERO, translated)
synonyms: The Kingdom of the Dragon of Fire

170970.description:
Years later, Tao Anzhi is glad that she went ahead and opened that door. It was like a blessing from god, for her to meet Yan Xi, grow up with her, and fall deeply in love with her. Yan Xi never thought she'd feel this kind of love, especially not with the girl she grew up with. Even though they live in different timelines, their lives are inextricably bound together over the years. Even when they were so young, they were so in love, without even realizing.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

170971.description:
"I can't hold back anymore," he said, pinning me to the door as he kissed me and started to touch me passionately. My younger coworker is so sweet and caring, but he has an unexpected, wolf-like side to him!

(Source: INKR)
synonyms: 過激大灰狼先生的極限性愛~讓妳高潮到喜歡上我為止!

title.native: 激しめオオカミくんの限界エッチ ～好きになるまでイかせます
title.romaji: Hageshime Ookami-kun no Genkai Ecchi: Suki ni Naru Made Ikasemasu

170972.description:
The story is about an introverted college girl, Tsubame Takashina, who meets a boy, Taisei Kyogoku, who encourages her to come out of her shell little by little.

(Source: Melon Books, translated)
synonyms: Yinka-chan, Whose Yin Level is Gradually Decreasing

title.native: 徐々に陰度が下がっていく陰キャちゃん

170973.description:
Yano & Shizuki get it on in this Breathless Momentum doujinshi from the creator behind the original series, Zeniko Sumiya!

(Source: Animate International)

Note: Originally released at J.GARDEN 54, was then licensed by Libre for digital release.

170974.description:
Furukawa Koto, the plainest girl in class, desperately wants the elusive Kishi-kun to notice her.

(Source: Nico Nico Seiga, translated)

Note: Self-published pre-serialization version of the manga.
synonyms: I’m a Plain Girl and I Want to Show Off My Sex Appeal

title.native: 地味子な私は色気を出したい
title.romaji: Jimiko na Watashi wa Iroke wo Dashitai

170975.description: En route to Nagoya in order to seek employment opportunities, Hidehiko Kida came across a mysterious feather which led him back to his old town in the countryside. After around 30 years of lost contact, Hidehiko ran into his kindhearted principal at his alma mater, only to be faced with a larger-than-life reunion with a figure of the past—his former classmate Mutsumi Fujii. Why is it that nobody but Hidehiko is able to see the wings on Mutsumi's back? Is such meeting pure coincidence or true serendipity? With white wings, is Mutsumi an angel or...

170976.description:
Because of his status as an illegitimate child, Nobuhira is forced to join a temple. Not wanting to become a monk, at age 15, he flees Kyoto to go to Edo with the help of his elder sister Takako, who would later become the wife to the shogun Iemitsu. Iemitsu then gives Nobuhira a house and land of his own. However, even though Nobuhira later marries a princess, he is not allowed to live with her as he is just a poor retainer of the shogun. But with his blade, Nobuhira will cut down the evils that lurk in Edo.

(Source: Anime News Network, edited)

title.native: 公家武者 松平信平

170977.description:
After graduating from high school, Ako Takamine travels across the sea to the Izu Islands on her mother's advice. She was supposed to enjoy a leisurely lifestyle there, but living on the isolated island of Aogashima turns out to be more difficult than she expected?!

(Source: ComicWalker, translated)

title.native: 今日からここで暮らシマす!?

170979.description: Okada Izou… "Izou the Slayer" is coming to America!? At the recommendation of Ryoma, Izou is assigned to escort Kaishuu Katsu, the military magistrate of the Tokugawa Shogunate, to travel to San Francisco on board the Kanrin Maru with a Japanese delegation to ratify the Treaty of Amity and Commerce between Japan and the United States. At the welcoming party, Izou is upset by the arrogant attitude of his patron, Richardson, and causes a big fuss. This leads to Izou's decision to stay in the United States! He travels all the way from the west coast to Washington, D.C. Along the way, he encounters various events and historical figures…

170980.description:
If I could live again, I'd like to be a cat… independent and not bound by the obsessive desire for human affection. And so, the dog's wish was granted. But before long, misfortune strikes and he stumbles into a river. When hope is all but lost, Miki rushes to his rescue. Moved by her kindness, he decides to dedicate his life to bringing her joy... only to find out that she's a dog person. Refusing to give up, he then vows to become Miki's new dependable "canine"!

A collection of peculiar yet heartwarming short stories depicting the bond between "cat" and human.

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Includes the following stories:
1. Wagahai wa Neko de Aru ga Inu
2. #Uchi no Neko ga Imouto Fast Sugiru
3. Wagahai wa Kyouju de Aru ga... Kamo?
4. Natsu no Aru Hi
5. Wagahai wa Game Jikkyousha de Ari Neko Channel ni Arazu
6. Wagahai wa Neko de Aru ga Kimi wa Inu
synonyms: I'm a Cat, but a Dog

title.english: I'm a Cat, Said the Dog
title.romaji: Wagahai wa Neko de Aru ga Inu

170981.description:
I met her for the first time today... But why is my heart beating so fast?!

(Source: DAYcomics)

170987.description:
1. Amai Sasayaki (甘いささやき,Sweet Whispers)
2. Tousui Aroma (陶酔あろま,Euphoria Aroma)
3. Yawaraka Affection (やわらかあふぇくしょん,Soft affection)
4. Kaoru Hitamuki (香るひたむき,Fragrant Dedication)
5. Senpai no Toriko (先輩のとりこ,Captivated by senpai)

170994.description:
Does she love you?
Your so called "mother."
No matter what she may be.
It is a bond that cannot be broken.

170995.description: A teenage boy returns to his remote home island from the mainland. While people have stopped wearing masks elsewhere, the rule to wear masks outside at all times is still surprisingly strict on this island. Could the reason be something other than corona?

title.native: ぼくらの夏が裂けていく

170997.description: In a world where human and non-human descendants coexist, Rio is a high school student descendant of vampires. As a result of his race, he’s feared by his classmates and he tries hard to go unnoticed. Independently of his intentions, Kairi, a human classmate, is always bugging him. Due to Kairi’s tactless words, the girl Rio likes hates him and in his desire to seek revenge, Rio decides to make Kairi his “servant”?!
synonyms: オレ様な同級生の眷属になりました
Oresama na Doukyuusei no Kenzoku ni Narimashita
I became the slave of a classmate

title.native: オレ様な同級生の眷属になりました
title.romaji: Oresama na Doukyuusei no Kenzoku ni Narimashita

170999.description:
The Cannibal Shark Void. That was the beginning of it all. Ten years later, science and technology research and marine experiments are flourishing in the "Dragon Palace," a mobile marine research city built on the sea. However, there is a terrible "legacy" hidden there. Some fear its existence, some seek its existence, and some try to find a ray of hope in its existence.
Is this hidden "legacy" hope for mankind or despair?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: シャークロアシリーズ
Sharklore-series Pandora shark of tomoshibi island

title.native: 炬島のパンドラシャーク
